claims.text: The preliminary experimental results indicate the difficulty of the task and serve as benchmarks for further experiments.
The experiments involved training a model to jointly predict holders, targets, and polar expressions as a sequence labeling task.
The paper presents the first experimental results on the dataset for neural machine learning of fine-grained opinions.
